feature_name: Kubernetes Worker Enhanced Logging and Error Hints
description: Add improved logging and user-friendly error hints to the Kubernetes worker. When Kubernetes jobs are created, log informational messages about the job creation process. When Kubernetes API errors occur, provide actionable resolution hints based on common error patterns before raising InfrastructureError.
functional_requirements: Add INFO-level logging when Kubernetes jobs are created in both the main run method and the internal run initiation method
Implement pattern-based error analysis for Kubernetes API failures to generate user-friendly resolution hints
Append generated error hints to InfrastructureError messages for common failure scenarios including 403 Forbidden, 404 with namespace errors, and quota exceeded errors
Create a dedicated helper method to analyze Kubernetes API errors and return appropriate resolution hints based on error patterns
